description: CRSP permanent security identifier (PERMNO). It identifies a security, not a company, and is the panel key with date.
Monthly observation date. CRSP uses its monthly calendar date; accepted provisional observations are aligned to the common last priced date for that calendar month.

Monthly total return as a decimal, including distributions. CRSP mthret already includes recorded delisting returns; only mthdelflg='M' rows receive the separately flagged -100% imputation, while provisional returns come from split- and dividend-adjusted Compustat daily wealth.
True only when CRSP mthdelflg='M' means the terminal return was excluded. The code compounds the configured -100% delisting assumption with mthret; all other rows are unchanged.
Month-end price in USD per share, stored as a positive value. Provisional months use the last accepted Compustat daily close for the month.
Shares outstanding in millions of shares. This is not split-adjusted; for comparable share-count histories multiply shares_out by mthcumfacshr, not divide.

Cumulative factor used to adjust shares for splits and similar events. In this CIZ panel adjusted shares equal shares_out multiplied by mthcumfacshr; provisional rows use Compustat ajexdi in the harmonized orientation.
Monthly trading volume in individual shares. Provisional months sum Compustat daily share volume.

Security-level market capitalization in USD millions, sourced from CRSP mthcap for historical rows and computed as price times shares for provisional rows. It should approximately equal price times shares_out but is not recomputed for historical observations or aggregated across share classes.
CRSP Standard Industrial Classification code for the security at that date.
Security ticker at that date. Provisional rows prefer the Compustat security ticker and fall back to the latest CRSP ticker.
Issuer or company name associated with the security. Provisional rows prefer the Compustat name and fall back to the latest CRSP issuer name.

True when the security belongs to the configured universe on that date. For the Russell 3000 proxy, June market-cap ranks set membership from July through the following June, while the panel retains pre-entry and post-exit history for every ever-member.
True for post-CRSP observations built from Compustat Security Daily; false for historical CRSP rows. Treat provisional data as replaceable when CRSP later refreshes.

True when a provisional monthly return exceeds the configured absolute-return threshold after the normal liquidity screen. Quarantined rows remain visible but are excluded from investable selections pending review.
Trailing three-month average daily dollar volume in USD per trading day, estimated from price times monthly share volume divided by weekday counts. It requires three consecutive calendar months.
Compustat Global Company Key attached through the date-valid CRSP/Compustat Merged link.
CCM primary-link marker for the selected security-company link; P and C are preferred to J when resolving overlaps.
Compustat security-level issue identifier from the CCM link. Use it together with gvkey when joining security-level Compustat data; gvkey alone can mix share classes.
CCM link type for the selected date-valid security-company link; the pipeline accepts configured LC, LU, and LS links.
Historical CRSP permanent company identifier linked to the Compustat record.
CCM flag indicating whether the link is used in construction of the composite link record.
First effective date of the selected CCM link.
Last effective date of the selected CCM link, extended by the build to the final calendar day of its month so the CRSP month-end remains covered.
True for the single selected in-universe security per gvkey and date, preferring CCM linkprim P or C and then larger market capitalization.
True for an in-universe linked security that loses the one-security-per-gvkey selection to the primary security on that date.
True when price meets the configured minimum of USD 5 per share.
True when security market capitalization meets the configured minimum of USD 50 million.
True when trailing three-month average daily dollar volume meets the configured USD 500,000 threshold.

True when the row is the selected primary in-universe security, passes the price, market-cap, and liquidity screens, and is not quarantined. Signals are standardized and portfolios are formed only among these rows.
Settlement date of the latest Compustat security-level short-interest report available on or before the panel date.
Unadjusted shares held short as of short_interest_date, converted to millions of shares in the panel.
Split-adjusted shares held short as of short_interest_date, converted to millions of shares. The sentiment signal compares this with shares_out multiplied by mthcumfacshr.
